تعتاضون (form VIII)
# تَعْتَاضُونَ (taʕtāḍūna) /taʕ.taː.dˤuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِعْتَاضَ (iʕtāḍa)
# تُعْتَاضُونَ (tuʕtāḍūna) /tuʕ.taː.dˤuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَاضَ (iʕtāḍa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
